title: Business Flow Model
description: Defines business flows that relate to technical architectures, allowing mapping of flows to technical components and attaching control requirements.

flow.description: A business flow, as an ordered list of transitions across the architecture's relationships.

name.description: Descriptive name for the business flow

description.description: Detailed description of the flow's purpose

requirement-url.description: Link to a detailed requirement document

transitions.description: The steps of the flow, each across one relationship.

controls.description: The controls that apply to this flow.

transition.description: One step of a flow, across one relationship of the architecture.

relationship-unique-id.description: Unique identifier for the relationship in the architecture

sequence-number.description: Indicates the sequence of the relationship in the flow

description.description: Functional summary of what is happening in the transition

direction.description: Which way along the relationship the step goes.
